files.views_included: labelled isometric view + orthographic views + sections (all on the one sheet)
files.why_orthographic_and_sections_are_includ: The isometric view on this sheet carries NO dimensions; every dimension is on the orthographic/section views. Sending the isometric alone would give the model no dimensions (brief 2.7.1 allows essential orthographic/section views when justified and logged).
